entries.reason: the port implements UIListContentConfiguration itself - UIListContentConfiguration.m:41, because neither band end carries the class - and that implementation ALREADY owns the value 18.0 published as a property: the _alpha ivar (UIListContentConfiguration.m:58), the -initCharonWithStyle: default of 0 for a bare configuration and 1 otherwise (:151), the NSCoding round trip under the key "alpha" (:232, :258), -copyWithZone: (:285), -isEqual: (:525) and the -description text (:544). UIListContentView.m:187 already reads it and sets the alpha on the text, secondary text and image views. So the storage 18.0's accessor writes is the storage the drawing path already reads, and the only thing 18.0 added is that a caller can reach the value; -alpha and -setAlpha: are written in the same shape as the -image/-setImage:/ -textProperties pair this file already defines, and -charon_alpha is left beside them because UIListContentView.m:187 reads it. A property's NAME is not always its selector, so the spelling was checked before the row was written: the 16.4 SDK's own UIListContentConfiguration.h declares the whole class and 18 properties and ZERO occurrences of "alpha", and every one of those properties uses the plain spelling, and the registry's own source sdk-26.2-surface.tsv:123512 records UIListContentConfiguration.alpha at 18.0 as a plain property - so the selector is alpha, not isAlpha
entries.effect: the accessors are EXPORTED, so an application that names them links and a guarded call finds them. The value is the port's own, not a stand-in: what a caller sets is what UIListContentView.m applies to the three views it draws, and it round-trips through -copyWithZone:, -isEqual: and the coder, exactly as the ivar the object already had. A configuration built by +cellConfiguration and friends reads back the alpha its style gave it (1, or 0 for a bare one), so leaving the property alone preserves the value rather than resetting it. 6.1.3 has no list configuration of its own to compare against, so nothing on this release reads the accessor back
entries.source: read out of the port's own sources, the line numbers above being that reading; the object's selector table confirms the definition rather than the source, compiled for armv7-apple-ios6.1.3 against the 16.4 SDK: otool -v -s __TEXT __objc_methname lists alpha and setAlpha: beside charon_alpha. The SDK's own declaration of the class and of alpha's absence read from ~/.xmake/packages/i/iphoneos-sdk/16.4/*/iPhoneOS16.4.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/UIKit.framework/Headers/UIListContentConfiguration.h, and the introduced version from coordination/corpus/sdk-26.2-surface.tsv:123512
